name: SimpleAds
project_description:
What is the SimpleAds module? 
 A Drupal module to create advertisement blocks, create advertisement campaigns and view advertisement statistics.

 Key Features 
 
 Create advertisement blocks with ability to show ads with auto ad rotation and other settings. 
 Views integration and SimpleAds reference fields that allows individually pick ads and show them in any other entities.  
 View and export advertisement performance statistics. 
 The module comes with CKEditor 5 plugin that allows you to inject advertisement blocks right into your content. 
 Responsive advertisement type allows you to add 3 types of images specific to mobile, tablet and desktop devices. 
 Create campaigns and configure its activity by impressions, clicks and/or date (whichever comes first). 
 
 How to use SimpleAds module? 
 Get the code like any other module.

 composer require drupal/simpleads
